competitors.name: WE-001 Cassette Player
competitors.summary: A contemporary portable cassette alternative with Bluetooth, wired headphones and rechargeable power; its heavier aluminium case contrasts with the planned slim CP11.

competitors.name: CP-81 Portable Cassette Player
competitors.summary: A basic new-build portable cassette player with recording, a 3.5 mm headphone jack and AA power, competing for listeners who want a simple tape player.
